verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a desktop and cloud agent-orchestration product, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The Advanced Metrics release note describes collecting and viewing usage metrics, which is a different feature from opting out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
